modularCharacterSystem.godotPreview: godot/scripts/main.gd AvatarPreview draws every character creation field used by the web version.
modularCharacterSystem.modelLibrary: godot/scripts/model_library.gd creates rounded proxy 3D bodies, eyes, hair, beard/face cues, armor trim, stones, weapons, tools and creature silhouettes.
modularCharacterSystem.shapeQualityRule: Avoid visible square blockouts in final-facing previews. Use capsules, spheres, cylinders, cones, softened shields, cloth silhouettes and clean sockets; BoxMesh is reserved only for hidden collision or deliberate hard-surface props.
modularCharacterSystem.finalPipeline: Replace proxy MeshInstance3D parts with signed-off .glb files that keep the same socket and slot names.
